thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for inference-gateway in us-west-2. Error rate spike starting ~2334567600. Auto-alert threshold breached (5m window).
Jamie: acked. I'm oncall. pulling dashboards now.
Ashley: I see the spike too — 502s and 504s from gateway to runtime pool. Latency upstream also > 2x.
Mario: throwing an early guess — we've been seeing KV prefix cache evictions in canary logs earlier today, could be related.
Jamie: noted. Kevin can you confirm customer-facing impact (errors in API layer)?
Kevin: seeing retries and some customer 5xx reports. Estimated ~4% of requests failing for a subset of customers hitting long sequences. No big billing alerts yet.
Ryan: I'm running the quick health query on prefix-cache metrics.
Ryan: ```
# prometheus: rate(kv_prefix_evictions_total[5m]) > 0
kv_prefix_evictions_total{shard="s2"}  138
gateway_5xx_rate  0.042
runtime_502s  0.035
```
Mario: those eviction counts are suspiciously high for s2. Could be a mem leak or eviction storm after rolling configuration change last night.
Ashley: checking the runtime logs for KV corruption errors. grep for "kv-prefix-corrupt".
Ashley: ```
2026-03-15T10:30:12Z ERROR kv-store shard=s2 key=prefix_0x7a: checksum mismatch
2026-03-15T10:31:03Z WARN  eviction triggered for prefix_0x7a
```
Jamie: hmm checksum mismatch + eviction could lead to cache misses which cascade to cold loads, saturating backends and causing timeouts.
Lia: adding context — we rolled a smaller patch to eviction thresholds in s2 at 03:12 UTC. That aligns with metric drift.
Kevin: customers affected are primarily mid-size tenants with long-conversation contexts; they send long prompt sequences so they hit prefix paths heavily.
Mario: immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce aggressive eviction by setting threshold back to previous value, 2) temporarily divert traffic from s2 to s1/s3 for new sessions, 3) enable fallback model variant with local memcache for critical customers.
Jamie: agree. Ashley, can you roll the threshold revert? Use canary then scale.
Ashley: will do. Pushing config revert now to s2 only. ```
$ rctl config set kv.eviction.threshold 0.75 --target s2 --who=ashley
Deploy started: cfg-revert-2334567890
```
deploy-bot: deploy job cfg-revert-2334567890 started by Ashley. Job id dpl-9002.
Ashley: revert rolled to 10% of s2 nodes canary, monitoring error rate.
Ryan: setting routing rule to divert 20% new sessions off s2. ```
$ routerctl traffic-split set inference-gateway --remove s2 20% --add s1 10% --add s3 10%
```
Jamie: do we have a quick rollback plan if revert makes things worse?
Mario: yes — immediate rollback via deploy-bot cancel + routerctl revert. I have a command ready.
Kevin: notif to support: sending customer advisory to affected tenants, asking to expect intermittent 5xx while we mitigate.
Kevin: "We're aware of increased 5xx for some requests in us-west-2; mitigation in progress." :mailbox:
Ashley: canary node metrics: error rate down 60% on canary hosts after threshold revert. Latency tail improving.
Ryan: kv_prefix_evictions_total on canary: dropped from 138 -> 10 in 5m window. gateway_5xx_rate on canary hosts dropped to 0.008.
Jamie: good. Gradually expanding revert to all s2 nodes in 2 waves. I'll coordinate.
Mario: side investigation note — we also saw a single checksum mismatch causing full-prefix-eviction in the runtime library for keys with high refcounts. We'll open a follow-up PR to make evictions less aggressive on checksum failures.
Lia: logging note: capture the sample corrupted key and dump to staging for deeper debug. Ashley, can you stash logs to obs-runbook?
Ashley: uploaded logs to obs: https://obs.redwood/inbox/2334567890/corrupt-sample.log and added runbook snippet.
Jamie: current status: mitigation applied, traffic diversion active, error rates falling cluster-wide. Customer impact reduced but not fully resolved. Need handoff for overnight monitoring.
Jamie: handing off to Ashley for overnight watch and to own postmortem. Please include a timeline and root cause hypothesis. 
Ashley: taking handoff. I'll escalate to Mario for code fix for the eviction behavior. Will create an incident ticket and timeline.
Mario: I'll prepare a patch for runtime to add a soft-fail on checksum mismatch to avoid full-prefix purge. Targeting hotfix in 48h.
Kevin: support message updated. I'll follow up with affected customers about temporary routing changes.
Jamie: final checklist before I go offline: 1) expand revert complete (in progress), 2) monitor 15m windows, 3) notify paging if error rate > 1% again.
Jamie: thanks all — leaving the channel at 2334568240 for handoff. :white_check_mark:
Ashley: acked. I'll keep channel updates and escalate if we see reappearance.
deploy-bot: deploy cfg-revert-2334567890 completed on all s2 nodes at 2334568228.
Mario: noted for postmortem: root cause likely a coupling between checksum-handling path and eviction threshold change + high refcount prefixes causing eviction storm.
Ashley: creating postmortem ticket: INC-2334567890 in tracker, will include timeline, impact, mitigations, and remediation plan.
Jamie: thanks team.
